authorization_request_note: This plan is the draft authorization package. No owner authorization has been requested or granted; T1-B..E cannot run under the v3 protocol and require a v4 forward protocol/driver.
classification_scope: T1-B..E forward execution plan; T1-A is complete and is not resumed
objective: Complete the A3b T1 sensitivity matrix on the frozen configuration set, within the 4,320 s global cap, without modifying v2/v3 artifacts or claiming convergence/periodicity.

v2_v3_traceability.conclusion: V3 continues the frozen v2 protocol with unchanged scientific fields; cycles 1-2 are carried forward with matching primary hashes and cycle 3 is the only new solver state.

atol_freeze.rule: T1-B..E must consume this exact table. No tolerance may be derived from, or adjusted using, later T1-B..E results. NOT_EVALUATED observables remain NOT_EVALUATED even if a later result has a numerical value.

zero_step_preflight.conclusion: All five configurations pass identity/configuration/memory checks with zero solver steps. This covers T1-B..E preflight but does not authorize execution.

budget.headroom_explanation: The prereg's 50 s headroom uses the full T1-A cap of 600 s. T1-A actually used 530.469 s, so the actual remaining headroom is 119.531 s; the cap-conservative figure is not a refund.
budget.stress_10pp_effect: If the +10 pp rejection stress materializes, the affected configuration is PARTIAL under the frozen cap; no extension, no retry, no post-hoc horizon change.

marginal_invocation_risk.effect_if_materialized: The driver marks the invocation INTERRUPTED_CHECKPOINTED at the 595 s internal deadline. A retry would add a cycle and likely exceed the affected config's cap; that config would be PARTIAL, not COMPLETE. No retry beyond the cap is authorized.
marginal_invocation_risk.mitigation: Run T1-B invocation 1 (2 cycles) first as the canary for the 578.2 s envelope, then T1-D and T1-E, then T1-B invocation 2 and T1-C. If a marginal invocation is interrupted, stop that configuration and classify PARTIAL with exact evidence; do not retry or extend the cap. The owner must explicitly accept this residual risk in the execution authorization. A v4 driver may use a documented internal deadline up to the frozen 600 s per-invocation cap only if the new addendum binds it; the 595 s value must not be silently edited.
recommended_execution_order: v4 zero-step, lineage and budget preflight; zero solver steps.
T1-B invocation 1 (2 cycles): canary for the 578.2 s envelope.
T1-D (3 cycles) and T1-E (3 cycles): low-risk data first.

t1c_risk.effect_if_materialized: A T1-C cycle at the observed-adjusted upper bound would be interrupted at 595 s; T1-C would be PARTIAL, not COMPLETE. No retry beyond the 2,100 s cap is authorized.
t1c_risk.mitigation: T1-B invocation 1 is the canary for the same 578.2 s envelope. If it passes, run T1-C; if T1-C is interrupted, stop T1-C and classify PARTIAL.

execution_requirements.required_new_protocol: v4 forward protocol/addendum that carries forward the v3 ledger (530.469 s, three T1-A entries) and authorizes T1-B..E only; v2 and v3 remain frozen and unmodified.
execution_requirements.required_new_driver: v4 matrix-completion driver with the same identity/preflight, audit/replay, checkpoint and fail-closed contracts; one ledger; no edits to v2/v3 artifacts.
execution_requirements.required_authorization: Owner execution authorization quoting the v4 protocol, driver and addendum SHA-256, the four caps and invocation plans, the 4,320 s global cap, the 600 s per-invocation cap, the 595 s internal deadline, and the T1-C residual-risk decision.
required_preflights: v4 lineage preflight: carry forward the v3 ledger and T1-A result/checkpoint; zero solver steps.
v4 zero-step preflight: T1-B, T1-C, T1-D, T1-E identity/configuration/memory checks; zero solver steps.
v4 budget preflight: assert global spent + remaining caps <= 4,320 s and each projected invocation <= 600 s/595 s.

worker_and_memory_policy.T1-B_T1-C: 1 worker sequential; 48-cell configurations at ~2.0 GiB each would consume 100% of the 4,096 MiB aggregate cap if overlapped.
worker_and_memory_policy.T1-D: up to 3 workers; planning 1.05 GiB per worker; sequential is the default.
worker_and_memory_policy.T1-E: up to 4 workers; planning 0.70 GiB per worker; sequential is the default.
worker_and_memory_policy.note: The 28/18-cell RSS values are interpolated, not measured; the v4 preflight must retain the memory checks.

acceptance_conditions: T1-B, T1-C, T1-D and T1-E each complete 3 cycles with a recomputed PASS audit and next_cycle=4, or are explicitly classified PARTIAL with exact evidence.
Global charged time <= 4,320 s; each configuration <= its frozen cap; each invocation <= 600 s and, unless a v4 addendum binds otherwise, <= 595 s internal deadline.
The v3 ledger is carried forward exactly (112.094 s failed + 266.469 s partial + 151.906 s cycle 3 = 530.469 s); no refund, reclassification or reset.
The analysis-freeze table is unchanged; no tolerance is derived from later results; NOT_EVALUATED observables remain NOT_EVALUATED.
No v2 or v3 artifact, protocol, driver, addendum, checkpoint, result or ledger is modified.
The analysis status becomes COMPLETE_MATRIX only if all four configs are COMPLETE; otherwise it remains INCOMPLETE_MATRIX/PARTIAL.
No global convergence verdict, no periodicity identification, no predictive or experimental-validation claim; claim scope is transient cycles 1-3 only.
stop_rules: Any hash, identity, configuration, lineage or ledger mismatch.
Any attempted T1-A re-run or any attempted edit to v2/v3 artifacts.
Global charged time would exceed 4,320 s, or a configuration would exceed its cap.
An invocation reaches 600 s or the 595 s internal deadline without completing its cycle.
NaN/Inf, conservation mismatch, or a checkpoint/audit failure.
T1-B invocation 1 or T1-C interruption at the marginal envelope: do not retry beyond the affected config's cap; classify PARTIAL.
Any tolerance change or any use of later results to alter the frozen atol table.
The +10 pp stress projection would exceed 4,320 s; stop the affected configuration and classify PARTIAL; no extension.
non_claims: A3b T1 is a first numerical sensitivity evaluation, not a definitive convergence closure.
No steady-state convergence and no periodicity identification.
No power or torque curve is produced by this protocol.
No claim outside the studied mesh/CFL domain.
No supported resolution domain from T1-A alone.
open_issues: T1-B invocation 1 and T1-C each have an observed-adjusted upper invocation of 596.144 s, 1.144 s above the 595 s internal deadline but 3.856 s below the 600 s cap; residual risk must be accepted or a v4 deadline policy must be explicitly bound.
T1-B..E cannot run under the v3 protocol; a new v4 protocol and driver are mandatory before authorization.
28/18-cell memory values are interpolated, not measured; the v4 preflight must keep the 3,072 MiB per-process and 4,096 MiB aggregate checks.
Rejection share at CFL 0.2/0.1 and coarse meshes is unknown; the +5 pp and +10 pp cases are planning stresses, not predictions.
No per-configuration RSS series exists for 28/18 cells; the first v4 run should record it.
